items.title: Obtain and renew a Beaverhead County food establishment license
items.authority: Beaverhead County Environmental Health / Montana Department of Public Health and Human Services
items.description: Food establishments operating in Beaverhead County must obtain the applicable Montana food license and comply with county inspection requirements before operating.

feeDetail.note: The county application lists $85 for establishments with one or two employees working at a time and $115 for three or more; Montana's current retail-food categories range from $150 to $275 by size.

lateFee.note: Montana adds a $25 late fee when renewal is not submitted before expiration and the establishment operates in the next licensing year.

lateFee.note: Montana law requires a $25 late fee when a retail-food renewal is submitted after expiration and the establishment operates in the next licensing year.
